name: com.openugd.corelib
description: The Unity boundary of the OpenUGD family, in five assemblies. com.openugd.corelib holds ContextBehaviour, a MonoBehaviour that boots a com.openugd.context Context and exposes the Unity loop as signals, with coroutine and SynchronizationContext seams a test can replace. Three engine-free assemblies add a presenter tree for view composition (com.openugd.presenters), a command mapper for message handling (com.openugd.commands) and tagged logging (com.openugd.logging); com.openugd.logging.unity writes that log to the Unity console.

samples.description: A ContextBehaviour that boots two services - constructor injection, IAwakeService then IInitializeService, a signal property, a coroutine through ICoroutineProvider - and logs to the Unity console through a LogRoot rooted at PlaySession.Lifetime, so everything ends with the play session.

A presenter tree on a host's scope: Presenter.Attach with ContextPresenterFactory, [Inject] members on presenters created with new, a view swap that shows ViewLifetime unwiring the old view, a presenter that closes with its view (CloseWith), and the teardown order, logged step by step.

A shop wired with the command map: commands mapped by type (checked at registration), by factory and as a one-time registration, a registration undone, a refusal rethrown to the caller of Tell, a per-execution Lifetime, and a listener that hears every message.

Several game instances in one process, one per display, with input and audio focus switched between them: the 0.6.x ContextInstanceComponent, ContextFactoryInstancesComponent and IContextInstanceProvider, moved out of the package in 2.0.0 and fixed. The scripts keep their 0.6.x GUIDs, so existing prefabs and scenes bind to them after the import.
